wrong.why: The servants killed Joash, while Amaziah his son subsequently reigned in his place.

missing.why: The verse explicitly includes Jehoshaphat among Jehoash's fathers (אֲבֹתָיו), meaning his ancestors.
The verse explicitly includes Jehoram among Jehoash's fathers (אֲבֹתָיו), meaning his ancestors.

note: Ahaziah is also named among Jehoash's ancestors, but their father–son relationship is already recorded from another chapter.
